$comment: 8.5 and 8.8's shared constants, and S6's two bases (GAME_DESIGN B.6, B.3, 9.5; BUILD_PLAN S6). Whole numbers only, so web/js/engine/odds.js prices a choice exactly: p = clamp(base + its labeled modifiers, clamp), shaky = min(ceil((100 - p) / 2), shaky_cap), made = p + shaky; a skill adds skill_per_level for each level (8.5: a beginner's level 1 is +2); great_below is the Great band's distance under p (8.8) and routine_at the p from which a check is told, not asked (8.5). Each base names the line its Why-sheet row reads (label: display data, so tools/content.mjs sends it to voice.json, never rules.json), as each skill does. Shipped in rules.json as odds with the trail (content/scope/m1a.json ships). S9 grows this into rules/mods.json and rules/tuning.json.
